# Durgesh Chavda — Chartered Accountant & Virtual CFO

> CA Durgesh Chavda is a Chartered Accountant (ICAI) and Virtual CFO based in Ahmedabad, India, with offices in Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Rajkot and Dubai. He advises VC-backed startups, founders and family offices on fundraising, investor reporting, FEMA/RBI compliance (FC-GPR, FC-TRS, ODI), GST and direct tax, valuation and cross-border structuring (US Delaware, Singapore, DIFC, Mauritius). He led and closed a USD 3.75M Pre-Series A for AI EdTech company Stimuler, and is Managing Partner at Finvy.

Contact: hello@durgeshchavda.com · WhatsApp/phone +91 78018 87130 · LinkedIn https://linkedin.com/in/ca-durgesh-chavda-bb08a6b0
